notes: Chicka Chicka 1,2,3 is a counting/number concept book where numerals 1-100 climb an apple tree and then fall down, with a bee character appearing throughout. Core vocabulary already covers 'more' and fixed rows cover 'stop' and 'go' which are useful for this book. The hero slot uses a generic apple tree which Boardmaker covers well — no named or distinctive character exists in this book. 'hundred' (100) is a key concept as the numbers go all the way to 100 and '100' numeral symbols are available in Boardmaker. 'again' is already listed in existing aac_extras so its icon may already be available. 'up' and 'down' are in existing aac_extras as well — confirm these are included in the printed board layout even if sourced from aac_extras folder.
